about: The collecta of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Day” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that the new birth in the flesh of Thine Only-begotten Son may free us, whom the old bondage holdeth beneath the yoke of sin. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
